author: github@nwdxlgzs
changes: Native copies use durable 1 MiB pinned-source chunks and idempotent publication receipts
Direct directory downloads preserve committed local sidecar pieces within unfinished files and COW-publish verified output
Browser ZIP compression saves CRC, ZIP64 metadata and bounded fflate compressor snapshots within unfinished files
Without native local filesystem APIs, browser-generated ZIP chunks use an IP-bound private host spool and native Range download
Server-side ZIP journals and byte checkpoints commit atomically; per-task immutable checkpoint requests are serialized
Mounted uploads preserve staged offsets and validate the full acknowledged source-prefix SHA-256 chain after reselection
Provider COW publication streams 256 KiB ranges from the private spool; host replicas reuse existing bytes without provider reupload or double billing
Cross-mount moves and browser rename fallback copy, verify destination and conditionally delete the original source generation; directories remove only when empty
Mounted-source versions are distinct from host replica versions; changed/skipped/frozen source content is retained
Provider payloads keep independent admission budgets, including max-transfers=1
Private spool limits share the resumable storage budget; capabilities bind IP and share namespace, protected config is rejected
Single generated CMake version for CLI, banner, HTTP, status and MCP; file identification/suffix advice retained on mounted upload receipts
Plain uploads coalesce network fragments into bounded buffers before durable quota writes; early EOF accounts the short tail without publishing
IE11 ES5 compatibility, prefixed Blob slicing fallbacks, bounded retries and cancellation cleanup retained; long transfers have no fixed 60-second client deadline
regressionNote: Complete regressions, native CTest and shipped-browser checks ran against the final runtime implementation. Both complete release suites used the exact distributed files identified above, including bundle/version checks, private transfer/copy/move, actual mid-file ZIP recovery and mixed load. Native inputs are preserved in native-v310-sha256.json.

validationBoundaries: Actual Windows 7 was not available; PE subsystem 6.01 and system-DLL imports were checked
macOS source adaptation retained; no macOS test was run, as requested
IE11 previously accepted by the user; this increment has ES5/missing-API checks and docs/verification/ie-v310.md, not a new native IE rendering verdict

Native filesystem authorization/reopened handles and external-program races are covered by handle/IndexedDB doubles plus actual HTTP; physical browser picker and cross-device WebRTC acceptance are not replaced by those tests
Browsers without FileReader/Blob slicing retain legacy PUT and require restarting that file after page closure; browsers cannot silently recover disk permission
Direct-directory recovery may refetch the last uncommitted local part (at most 16 MiB); ZIP rolls back to its saved compressor checkpoint
Native download completion remains browser-managed; generated ZIP spools remain until cancellation or the configured expiry to support Range resume
resolvedRegression: Repeated musl concurrent-upload timeouts were traced with syscalls to quota fsync on 512-byte network fragments. Bounded body coalescing reduced the local 600 KB two-client quota test from about 7-8 seconds to about 0.1 seconds across 20 successful repetitions. Early-EOF accounting and repeated concurrent quota races are covered by the final regression; no failed run is counted as passed.
